---
title: "Figure 4 – Collecting Duct cell analysis across timepoints"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2026-06-01"
output: html_document
description: >
  (B) UMAP of CD subsets (ICA, ICB, PC, DegCD).
  (C) Proportion of CD subsets across timepoints (0, 3, 7, 28 dpi).
  (D) DotPlot of canonical CD subset markers.
  (E) UMAPs of CD cells split by timepoint.
  (G) Spatial feature plots of representative CD markers (Atp6v1g3, Slc4a1, Slc26a4, Aqp2) across timepoints.
  (H–I) DotPlots of subset-by-timepoint expression for additional CD markers.
  (J) PROGENy pathway activity heatmap across CD subsets and timepoints.
  (K) DotPlot of AMP gene expression across CD subsets and timepoints.
  (L) GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot for each CD subset.

Input:
  Single-cell: ICPC_Subclusters/ICPCcells_DegCD_v02142025.RDS
  Spatial:     Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_with_PROGENyCandidatePath_v05292026.rds

Output: Results/Figures/Figure4/

## Load data

```{r load-data}
# Single-cell CD object (ICA / ICB / PC / DegCD annotated)
CDcells <- readRDS(paste0(SCIndir, "ICPCcells_DegCD_v02142025.RDS"))
CDcells <- UpdateSeuratObject(CDcells)

# Ordered CD subset levels
subset_order    <- c("ICA", "ICB", "PC", "DegCD")
timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")

# Set identity to CD subset annotation
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)

cat("CD subset counts:\n")
print(table(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot))
cat("Timepoints:\n")
print(table(CDcells@meta.data$DataSet))
```

## Shared setup

```{r shared-setup}
# Combined subset × timepoint identity (used in H, I, J, K)
CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint <- paste(
  CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot,
  CDcells@meta.data$DataSet,
  sep = "_"
)

combined_order <- paste(
  rep(subset_order, each = length(timepoint_order)),
  timepoint_order,
  sep = "_"
)
combined_order <- combined_order[combined_order %in% unique(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint)]

# Canonical CD marker gene sets
ICA_markers  <- c("Atp6v1g3", "Aqp6", "Slc4a1", "Slc26a7", "Kit")
ICB_markers  <- c("Slc26a4", "Spink8", "Hmx2")
PC_markers   <- c("Aqp2", "Hsd11b2", "Scnn1g", "Syt7")
canonical_cd <- c(ICA_markers, ICB_markers, PC_markers)
```

## Figure 4B: UMAP of CD subsets

```{r fig4b-umap, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)

Fig4B_UMAP <- DimPlot(
  CDcells,
  label    = TRUE,
  repel    = TRUE,
  pt.size  = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "Collecting Duct subsets") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4B_CD_UMAP.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4B_UMAP,
  width    = 5, height = 4
)
Fig4B_UMAP
```

## Figure 4C: Proportion of CD subsets across timepoints

```{r fig4c-proportion, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
prop_df <- table(CDcells@meta.data$DataSet, CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, Subset = Var2) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order),
    Subset    = factor(Subset,    levels = subset_order)
  )

Fig4C_Prop <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = pct, fill = Subset)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion", title = "CD subset proportions across timepoints") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4C_CD_Proportion.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4C_Prop,
  width    = 4, height = 4
)
Fig4C_Prop
```

## Figure 4G: Spatial feature plots of representative CD markers across timepoints

```{r fig4g-spatial-features, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
spatial_cd_markers <- c("Atp6v1g3", "Slc4a1", "Slc26a4", "Aqp2")
myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))

for (m in spatial_cd_markers) {
  skip_to_next <- FALSE
  tryCatch(
    print(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]),
    error = function(e) { skip_to_next <<- TRUE }
  )
  if (skip_to_next) next

  Maxvalue <- ceiling(max(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))
  Minvalue <- floor(min(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))

  CDMarkerSpatialFeature <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = m,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = myPalette(4),
      limits  = c(Minvalue, Maxvalue)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4G_Spatial_", m, "_CDMarker.pdf"),
    plot     = CDMarkerSpatialFeature,
    height   = 3,
    width    = 15
  )
}
```

## Figure 4J: PROGENy pathway activity heatmap across CD subsets and timepoints

```{r fig4j-progeny, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint, levels = combined_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

# Run PROGENy via decoupleR MLM
net_cd  <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = "mouse", top = 500)
mat_cd  <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"))

acts_cd <- run_mlm(
  mat     = mat_cd,
  net     = net_cd,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "weight",
  minsize = 5
)

CDcells[["pathwaysmlm_cd"]] <- acts_cd %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source", names_from = "condition", values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("source") %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "pathwaysmlm_cd"
CDcells <- ScaleData(CDcells)

# Average scaled activity per subset × timepoint
df_cd <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "pathwaysmlm_cd", layer = "scale.data"))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(group = Idents(CDcells)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -group, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(group, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

cd_acts_mat <- df_cd %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "group", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>%
  column_to_rownames("group") %>%
  as.matrix()

PathwayOrder_cd <- c(
  "NFkB", "TNFa", "Hypoxia", "JAK-STAT",
  "Trail", "p53",
  "MAPK", "EGFR", "PI3K", "VEGF",
  "TGFb", "WNT", "Estrogen"
)
PathwayOrder_cd <- PathwayOrder_cd[PathwayOrder_cd %in% colnames(cd_acts_mat)]
groups_present  <- combined_order[combined_order %in% rownames(cd_acts_mat)]

CDHeatmapMat <- t(cd_acts_mat)[PathwayOrder_cd, groups_present]

palette_length <- 100
cd_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(palette_length)
cd_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0,   length.out = ceiling(palette_length / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 2, length.out = floor(palette_length / 2)))

Fig4J_Progeny <- pheatmap(
  CDHeatmapMat,
  fontsize       = 7,
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  color          = cd_color,
  breaks         = cd_breaks,
  main           = "PROGENy pathway activity – CD subsets × timepoints",
  angle_col      = 45,
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 0
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4J_CD_PROGENy_Heatmap.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
print(Fig4J_Progeny)
dev.off()
```

## Figure 4L: GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot for each CD subset

```{r fig4l-go-enrichment, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "SCT"

AllMarkers_cd <- FindAllMarkers(
  CDcells,
  min.pct         = 0.25,
  #logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use        = "MAST",
  only.pos        = TRUE
)

write.csv( 
  AllMarkers_cd,
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4L_CD_DEGs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

ClusterGenes_cd <- list(
  ICA   = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "ICA",   p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene),
  ICB   = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "ICB",   p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene),
  PC    = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "PC",    p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene),
  DegCD = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "DegCD", p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene)
)
# Remove empty groups
ClusterGenes_cd <- ClusterGenes_cd[sapply(ClusterGenes_cd, length) > 0]

GO_cd <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = ClusterGenes_cd,
  fun          = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb        = "org.Mm.eg.db",
  ont          = "BP",
  keyType      = "SYMBOL",
  pvalueCutoff = 1
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(GO_cd),
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4L_CD_GO_BP.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

selected_go_cd <- c(
"regulation of inflammatory response","chemokine production","phagocytosis","neutrophil activation","macrophage chemotaxis","granulocyte migration","Fc receptor mediated stimulatory signaling pathway","insulin receptor signaling pathway","leukocyte cell−cell adhesion","fibroblast migration","fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway","regulation of fibroblast proliferation","cellular respiration","response to hypoxia","NADP metabolic process","hydrogen peroxide catabolic process","reactive oxygen species metabolic process","hydrogen peroxide metabolic process","generation of precursor metabolites and energy","fatty acid metabolic process","organic acid catabolic process","carboxylic acid catabolic process","regulation of cellular pH","intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway","collecting duct development"
)

Fig4L_GO <- dotplot(
  GO_cd,
  showCategory = selected_go_cd,
  font.size    = 9,
  label_format = 60,
  by           = "geneRatio"
) +
  coord_flip() +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "GO Biological Process – CD subset DEGs") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4L_CD_GO_Dotplot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4L_GO,
  width    = 10, height = 4.5
)
Fig4L_GO
```
